fill.onlyFill: This version fills fields. Complete sign-in in the target app.
fill.previewHint: This diagram shows detected positions. Compare it with the target app. Cancel if the positions are wrong.
fill.cancelHint: Cancel stops future actions. Any text already entered remains.
fill.partial: Possibly entered: {{fields}}. Check the target app and clear the fields yourself before retrying.
fill.connectionLost: Task status is unavailable. A stop was requested. Check the target app for any text already entered.

phases.unlocking: Requesting Keychain access. Complete the system prompt…
phases.ready: Password ready. Start will switch to the target app and fill. Keep that window in front.
phases.filling: Filling. Keep the target app in front…
phases.filled: Fields filled. Check the target app and complete sign-in there.
phases.logged_in: Sign-in was submitted and the signed-in page was confirmed.
phases.user_completed: You confirmed completion. Sign-in status has not been automatically verified.
phases.prepare_login: Waiting for you to prepare the sign-in page
phases.checking: Rechecking the app and sign-in page…
phases.switch_ready: Password ready. Start will switch to the target app to sign out, fill, and sign in.
phases.switching: Switching accounts and signing in. Keep the target app in front…
phases.switch_challenge: Complete the required confirmation in the target app, then return and continue.

errors.busy: A sign-in task is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.expired: The task expired. Start a new task.
errors.cancelled: Task cancelled or focus changed during input.
errors.permission: Allow LoginDeck in macOS Accessibility settings, then start again.
errors.app_missing: The target app was not found.
errors.ambiguous: Multiple windows, instances or fields prevent identifying a unique target.
errors.login_page: Prepare the the target app username/password login page, then start again.
errors.not_empty: The fields already contain text. Check and clear them in the target app before retrying.
errors.focus_changed: The foreground window changed. Input stopped.
errors.identity_changed: App identity verification failed. Input stopped.
errors.timeout: The app did not respond in time. Input stopped.
errors.target_changed: The window, controls or focus changed. Check the login page.
errors.unavailable: The operation is unavailable. Check the app and try again.
errors.unsupported: No compatible built-in fill adapter is available for this app.
errors.credential_denied: Keychain access was cancelled or denied.
errors.account_changed: The account was changed or deleted. Refresh and try again.
errors.internal: The task could not complete. Try again later.
errors.invalid_adapter: The adapter configuration is invalid or damaged.
errors.adapter_mismatch: The adapter does not match the selected app.

fill.prepareLogin: The password sign-in page was not detected. If {{application}} is signed in, sign out there and open its password sign-in page. Then choose Continue checking to prepare the details for “{{account}}”. If filling fails after you sign out, complete sign-in in the app.

hints.password: The password is stored in the system Keychain. Supported apps can fill these credentials.
hints.sms: Only the phone number is saved, never verification codes. For now, enter the number and request and enter the code in the target app.

login.removePassword: Saving will remove the previously saved password from Keychain.
login.manualSms: Enter {{phone}} in the target app, request and enter the verification code yourself, then return here to confirm.
login.manualDone: I finished in the target app

adapter.title: Local app adapter
adapter.empty: Import a JSON file generated by the standalone recorder.
adapter.inactive: Configuration recognized, but this flow combination is not executable. Provide one sign-out flow and one flow that fills credentials, submits, and confirms the signed-in state.
adapter.review: Install {{id}} for this app. Review its controls and steps. Importing saves the configuration without running it.
adapter.refreshFailed: Configuration updated, but refresh failed. Retry the refresh.
adapter.switchConfirm: Use the imported configuration for {{application}}: sign out if already signed in, fill “{{account}}”, apply recorded sign-in options (which may include accepting terms), submit, and confirm the signed-in page.
adapter.loggedOut: The previous account was signed out. The new account is being signed in. Check the target app if this task fails or is cancelled.
adapter.logoutAttempted: Logout steps were attempted. Check the current state in the target app.
